Module.Name: pi-review
Module.Description: Patient Identity Conflict Review Assistant. An InterSystems IRIS interoperability production in which an AI Hub agent investigates synthetic patient identity conflicts, gathers case-scoped source evidence through native MCP tools and a governance knowledge base, and recommends a route for human review. The reviewer keeps control of identity mappings; the agent cannot approve a merge.
Module.AfterInstallMessage:
PI Review ObjectScript classes are now installed.
This module does NOT produce a running deployment. The application also needs, all of which are provisioned host-side and cannot be expressed in an IPM manifest: - the local embedding model for the AI Hub governance knowledge base - named Docker volumes holding MCP bearer credentials and gateway TOML configuration - iris-mcp-server gateway containers sharing the IRIS network namespace - Config Store / Wallet model profile setup
For a working instance use the Docker Compose bootstrap documented in README.md:
cp .env.example .env && chmod 600 .env && bash scripts/bootstrap.sh
Then open http://127.0.0.1:52784/identity/ and sign in with an IRIS administrator account holding %Admin_ConfigStore and %Admin_Wallet. Verify with scripts/test.sh.
Note: the static workbench assets (web/) and the synthetic source registry (data/source-registry.json) are read from /workspace at runtime and are supplied by the repository checkout or the Compose bind mounts, not by this module.
